subject: Green Tower
text: In the Green Tower, enter the middle door, go through another door, ascend the east stairs, take the next staircase up, walk south to another staircase up, and take it and the next one to reach the green pedestal.

evidence.quote:
Enter the middle door, followed by another door, and then go up the east 
stairs. Take the next staircase you see up as well. Walk south to another up
staircase, take it up along with the next one as well to get to the green 
pedestal.

subject: green jade
text: Placing the green jade on the pedestal activates it, after which you can fall off the side of the tower and head back to the red tower.

evidence.quote:
Place the green jade on it. Then fall off the side of the tower and
head back to the red tower.

subject: Red Tower
text: In the Red Tower, enter either eastern door, take the stairs up, head south through the door, take the stairs up, walk around to the next staircase, and ascend it and the following staircase to reach the red pedestal.

evidence.quote:
Enter either of the eastern doors and take the stairs up. Go south and enter
the door. Take the stairs up and walk all the way around to another staircase.
Take it up along with the next staircase as well to reach the red pedestal.

subject: red sapphire
text: Placing the red sapphire on the red pedestal transports the party to the isolated island where Elfrea is located.

evidence.quote:
Place the red sapphire on it and your party will be transported to the isolated
island Elfrea is located on.

subject: Inn
text: The inn in Elfrea is free of charge.

subject: flower patch
text: Searching the flower patch to the west upon entering Elfrea yields a hidden spell potion.

evidence.quote:
Walk north upon entering and search the flower patch to the west for a hidden
spell potion.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chests in the northern house in Elfrea yields a speed potion and a mind potion.

evidence.quote:
Continue north until you enter a house. Open the two chests for
a speed potion and a mind potion.

subject: Artea
text: Artea gives the party Artea's Bow, which should be equipped on Jerin.

evidence.quote:
Go up the stairs to the west and we finally
get to speak with Artea. Equip Artea's Bow on Jerin once he gives it to you.

subject: Elfrea
text: Descending the east stairs in Elfrea and stepping on the warp pad takes the party to a small shrine, where a western warp pad leads outside to a new continent.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready to continue, go down 
the east stairs and step on the warp pad, which takes us to the...
small shrine. Enter the door to the west, step on the warp pad there, then 
exit the shrine, and we'll be outside on a new continent.

subject: southern bridge
text: Crossing the southern of the two bridges to the southeast leads to the town of Ranqs.

evidence.quote:
Walk southeast/east until 
you see two bridges. Cross the southern one and enter the town of Ranqs.

subject: Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Ranqs costs 100 Gold.

subject: Morning Star

subject: yellow flowers

evidence.quote:
Go to the northeast house with the old woman in it. Search the yellow flowers 
north of her house for a power potion.

subject: Ranqs
text: Exiting Ranqs and heading west leads into the Odel Tunnel.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready to continue, exit and
enter the Odel Tunnel to the west.

subject: invisible maze
text: To navigate the invisible maze in Odel Tunnel, walk two spaces east, one north, two east, four north, three west, one south, two west, one south, two west, two north, one east, one north, two east, and north.

evidence.quote:
Enter the room and walk two 
spaces east, one north, two east, four north, three west, one south, two west,
one south, two west, two north, one east, one north, two east, north and you're
out of the maze.

subject: Odel Tunnel
text: Ascending the stairs out of Odel Tunnel and walking southwest leads to the town of Odel.

evidence.quote:
Go up the stairs to exit the tunnel. Walk southwest and enter
Odel.

subject: chest

evidence.quote:
Proceed north until you see the entrance to the castle, then go west and open 
the chest for an ex potion.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chest down the stairs in Odel yields an ex magic.

evidence.quote:
Go down the stairs and open the chest for an ex 
magic.

subject: bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf down the stairs in Odel yields a miracle.

evidence.quote: Search the bookshelf for a miracle.

subject: flower patches
text: Searching the flower patches east of Odel Castle yields a speed potion, a mind potion, and a great potion.

evidence.quote:
Go east first and search the flower patches for a speed potion, mind 
potion, and, a great potion.

subject: lockers
text: Searching the lockers down two staircases west of Odel Castle yields a hi magic and a hi gourd.

evidence.quote:
Next go west of the castle, take the stairs down, 
and another staircase as well. Search the lockers for a hi magic and a hi 
gourd and then walk down another flight of stairs.

subject: chest
text: Following the underground path past warp pads leads to two chests containing a yellow ring and a stone cure.

evidence.quote:
Follow the path and step on 
the warp pad. Go north when you get to a four way intersection and step on the 
warp pad. Open the two chests for a yellow ring and a stone cure.

subject: yellow ring
text: The yellow ring serves as a very good defensive ring when equipped.

evidence.quote:
The yellow ring is why we came all that way, equip it and you'll see that it's a very 
good defensive ring.

subject: dressers
text: Searching the dressers in the north room of Odel Castle yields a spell potion, a power potion, and two hi magics.

evidence.quote:
Enter the north room 
and search the dressers for a spell potion, power potion, and two hi magics.

subject: knight
text: In the throne room of Odel Castle, speaking to the knight standing next to the princess and agreeing to help him initiates the quest.

evidence.quote:
Enter either of the two back to back staircases and you'll be in the thrown 
room. Speak to the knight standing next to the princess and agree to help him.

Go south and 
then up steps to a building with an old man and two chefs. Search the

subject: chest

evidence.quote:
Go down the stairs and open 
the four chests for a miracle, chop block, fry pan, and a small knife.

subject: man

evidence.quote:
Next go 
to the building west of the entrance. Speak to the man in there to trigger 
dialogue, then exit Lyden, and head back to Odel.
